_test_case_note: v0.0.2 TEST CASE 1 -- Ingestion & Schema Validation for an ASN.1 source. Proves an end-to-end load + schema mapping from real BER-encoded telecom CDR files: every record parses, every decoded field lands in the target table, and nothing is silently truncated. Source is the REAL PSGW schema (flowx_testing/BT_Testing/PSGW.asn1), not a toy module. EXERCISES THE v0.0.2 CHOICE-ROOT SUPPORT: PSGW's root PDU CallEventRecord is a CHOICE with 13 arms, so the decoded frame carries one nullable column per arm (sgsnPDPRecord, ggsnPDPRecord, ... pGWRecord) PLUS the synthetic '_choice' discriminator column naming the arm actually selected -- without which a consumer cannot tell 'arm absent' from 'arm present but NULL'. All 10 fixtures select the pGWRecord arm (the richest, 18-24 populated leaf values per record), so _choice = 'pGWRecord' on every row. ON asn1_pdu_name AUTO-DETECTION: the task asked to omit asn1_pdu_name and let the framework auto-detect the root PDU. asn1/decoder.py DOES implement this (detect_root_pdu_name/resolve_pdu_name, and it correctly returns 'CallEventRecord' for PSGW.asn1 -- verified directly), BUT that capability is NOT REACHABLE FROM A SPEC in the current tree: onboarding/spec_validator.py:1451 still declares asn1_pdu_name required=True, and ingestion/readers.py:762 reads source_config['asn1_pdu_name'] by subscript, which raises FrameworkConfigError('asn1 source_config missing required key') when the key is absent. Omitting it here would make this spec fail validation AND fail at pipeline runtime, so asn1_pdu_name is set EXPLICITLY to the value auto-detection itself resolves ('CallEventRecord'). Making auto-detection usable requires editing those two files in src/, which is outside this task's file scope -- reported as a blocker rather than worked around. ON THE FIXTURES: flowx_testing/BT_Testing/synthetic/psgw_synthetic.ber is NOT used, because it holds 10 records concatenated as back-to-back TLVs in ONE file, and the framework decoder calls compiled.decode() once on a whole file's bytes -- asn1tools then returns only the FIRST TLV silently, ingesting 1 row and dropping 9 while reporting success. notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_asn1_psgw_cdr_fixture.py therefore writes each record as its own .ber file (10 files -> 10 rows) and self-checks that invariant at seed time. flowx_testing/BT_Testing/tap311_sample.ber is likewise unused (malformed 16-byte payload matching no CHOICE arm). AUTO-DETECTION IS NOW EXERCISED: asn1_pdu_name is deliberately OMITTED from source_config, so asn1/decoder.py::detect_root_pdu_name resolves the root PDU from the module itself (PSGW.asn1 -> CallEventRecord, a 13-arm CHOICE). This was briefly unreachable from a spec -- spec_validator.py required the key and readers.py subscripted it -- both were made optional in 0.0.2 so the decoder's detection is actually usable. An explicitly supplied asn1_pdu_name still wins as an override.
_expected_result: bronze_psgw.psgw_cdr_raw holds exactly 10 rows. Every row: _asn1_decode_error IS NULL, _choice = 'pGWRecord', pGWRecord IS NOT NULL, and all 12 non-selected arm columns NULL. The pGWRecord struct exposes the full CallEventRecord/PGWRecord member set derived from PSGW.asn1 with no schema mismatch or truncation; the 9 members present in all 10 source records (recordType, servedIMSI, pGWAddress, chargingID, servingNodeAddress, recordOpeningTime, duration, causeForRecClosing, chargingCharacteristics) are non-null on every row. Quarantine table psgw_cdr_raw_quarantine stays EMPTY.

ingestion_flows.source_description: v0.0.2 TC1: BER-encoded PSGW packet-gateway call-event records decoded against the real PSGW.asn1 module. Root PDU CallEventRecord is a CHOICE (13 arms) -- decoding projects one column per arm plus the '_choice' discriminator. Fixtures are landed one record per .ber file by notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_asn1_psgw_cdr_fixture.py.

rules.expression: _choice <> 'pGWRecord' OR (pGWRecord.recordType IS NOT NULL AND pGWRecord.servedIMSI IS NOT NULL AND pGWRecord.chargingID IS NOT NULL)
_choice <> 'pGWRecord' OR pGWRecord.duration IS NULL OR pGWRecord.duration >= 0
